name: Plate Reader — Production Readiness Test Suite
description: Comprehensive test checklist for validating the Plate Reader SiLA 2 server prior to production deployment. Covers measurement workflows, parameter validation, observable property updates, and integration tests. Tests can be run in Simulation mode (no hardware required).

categories.name: Plate Management
categories.description: Plate insertion, ejection, and state tracking

tests.name: Insert plate
tests.description: Insert a plate into the reader. Verifies InsertPlate succeeds and IsPlateInserted becomes true.

tests.name: Insert then eject plate
tests.description: Insert a plate then eject it. Verifies EjectPlate succeeds after insertion.

tests.name: Eject without plate
tests.description: Attempt to eject a plate when none is inserted. Should return PlateNotInserted error.

tests.name: Double insert plate
tests.description: Insert a plate twice. Second insert should succeed (idempotent) or be a no-op.

categories.name: Measurement
categories.description: Plate measurement workflows and status queries

tests.name: Measure 96-well plate
tests.description: Run a measurement on a 96-well plate at 450nm. Verifies ResultsCsv is not empty.
tests.expected: RunMeasurement succeeds, ResultsCsv is not empty

tests.name: Measure 384-well plate
tests.description: Run a measurement on a 384-well plate at 450nm. Verifies ResultsCsv is not empty.
tests.expected: RunMeasurement succeeds, ResultsCsv is not empty

tests.name: Measure 24-well plate
tests.description: Run a measurement on a 24-well plate at 450nm. Verifies ResultsCsv is not empty.
tests.expected: RunMeasurement succeeds, ResultsCsv is not empty

tests.name: Measure without plate
tests.description: Attempt to run a measurement when no plate is inserted. Should return PlateNotInserted error.

tests.name: GetReaderStatus returns message
tests.description: Call GetReaderStatus and verify it returns a non-empty StatusMessage.

categories.name: Parameter Validation
categories.description: Verify command parameters are validated against FDL constraints

tests.name: Wavelength minimum (200nm)
tests.description: Run measurement at minimum wavelength (200nm). Should succeed.

tests.name: Wavelength maximum (1000nm)
tests.description: Run measurement at maximum wavelength (1000nm). Should succeed.

tests.name: Wavelength below minimum (199nm)
tests.description: Attempt to run measurement at 199nm (below minimum). Should be rejected.

tests.name: Invalid plate format (48)
tests.description: Attempt to run measurement with PlateFormat=48 (not in allowed values: 24, 96, 384). Should be rejected.

categories.name: WebUI Integration
categories.description: Tests for the React WebUI, SSE streaming, and user interface correctness

tests.name: Insert and eject plate via WebUI
tests.description: Open the Plate Reader WebUI, insert a plate, confirm it's shown, then eject and confirm it's removed.
tests.expected: WebUI accurately reflects plate insertion and ejection state

steps.message: Open the Plate Reader WebUI in your browser.
Does the WebUI show that a plate is inserted?
Does the WebUI show that the plate was removed?

tests.name: Measurement progress display
tests.description: Open the Plate Reader WebUI, insert a plate, run a 96-well measurement, and verify the WebUI shows progress (well-by-well intermediate responses).
tests.expected: WebUI displays measurement progress as intermediate responses arrive

steps.message: Open the Plate Reader WebUI in your browser.
Did the WebUI show well-by-well progress during the measurement?

tests.name: Results CSV display
tests.description: Open the Plate Reader WebUI, run a measurement, and verify the WebUI displays the final CSV results.
tests.expected: WebUI displays the CSV results after measurement completes

steps.message: Open the Plate Reader WebUI in your browser.
Does the WebUI display the final CSV results?

categories.name: LockController
categories.description: Server locking for exclusive access control

tests.name: Lock and unlock server
tests.description: Lock the server with a token, then unlock it.

tests.name: Lock when already locked
tests.description: Lock the server, then try to lock again with a different token.
tests.expected: Second lock attempt returns ServerAlreadyLocked error

tests.name: Unlock with wrong token
tests.description: Lock the server, then try to unlock with a different token.

categories.name: Structured Logging
categories.description: ServerLogProvider feature: structured log queries with filters

tests.name: GetLogs with no filters returns entries
tests.description: Query logs with no filters. Server should have logged startup entries.
tests.expected: Non-empty array of log entries returned

tests.name: GetLogs with MinSeverity=ERROR
tests.description: Query logs filtered to ERROR and above. All returned entries should be ERROR or CRITICAL.
tests.expected: All entries have level ERROR or CRITICAL (or empty if none)

tests.name: GetLogs with Feature=Server
tests.description: Query logs filtered to the Server feature. All returned entries should have feature 'Server'.

tests.name: GetLogs with MaxEntries=5 returns at most 5
tests.description: Query with MaxEntries=5 and verify no more than 5 entries are returned.

tests.name: GetLogFeatures returns feature list
tests.description: GetLogFeatures should return a list containing at least 'Server' (from startup logs).

tests.name: LogStats property returns valid JSON
tests.description: Read the LogStats property and verify it contains expected fields.
tests.expected: JSON with total_entries, counts_by_level, oldest_timestamp, newest_timestamp, db_size_bytes

categories.name: Script Runner — Execution
categories.description: Core script execution: output capture, exit codes, error handling, and the device helper preamble

tests.name: Simple print output
tests.description: Run a one-liner that prints 'hello' and verify it appears in FullOutput with exit code 0.

tests.name: Multi-line output
tests.description: Run a script with multiple print statements and verify all lines appear in FullOutput.

tests.name: Computation and formatted output
tests.description: Run a script that does arithmetic and string formatting, verify computed result in output.

tests.name: Standard library imports
tests.description: Verify scripts can import standard library modules (json, math, datetime).

params.ScriptCode:
import json, math, datetime
print('imports_ok')
print(json.dumps({'pi': round(math.pi, 2)}))

tests.name: Loop output
tests.description: Run a script with a for loop and verify output from each iteration.

tests.name: Syntax error produces non-zero exit code
tests.description: Run code with a syntax error. Should complete (not crash the server) with non-zero exit code and traceback in output.

tests.name: Runtime exception produces non-zero exit code
tests.description: Run code that raises a runtime exception. Should produce non-zero exit code with traceback.

tests.name: Empty script succeeds with exit code 0
tests.description: Run an empty (whitespace-only) script. Should succeed without error.

tests.name: FullOutput contains ScriptRunner banner
tests.description: Verify that ScriptRunner injects its own [ScriptRunner] Started and Finished banners into the output.

tests.name: Consecutive script executions
tests.description: Run two scripts back-to-back. Verify each produces independent output (no bleed-over).
tests.expected: First output contains 'first_run', second contains 'second_run' and not 'first_run'

categories.name: Script Runner — Device Helper
categories.description: Verify the injected `device` helper object works: introspection, print, sleep

tests.name: device object is available
tests.description: Verify the `device` object exists and is a DeviceHelper instance.

tests.name: device.print() writes to output
tests.description: Verify device.print() sends text to the captured output stream.

tests.name: device.features lists server features
tests.description: Verify device.features returns a list that includes PlateReader and ScriptRunner.

tests.name: device.commands() lists feature commands
tests.description: Verify device.commands('ScriptRunner') returns known command names.

tests.name: device.properties() lists feature properties
tests.description: Verify device.properties('ScriptRunner') returns IsRunning.

tests.name: device.property() reads a SiLA property
tests.description: Use device.property() to read the DeviceDescription property. Should not crash.

tests.name: device.command() calls SiLA command (simulation)
tests.description: Use device.command() to call GetReaderStatus and verify the response.

categories.name: Script Runner — Persistence
categories.description: Save, load, list, delete, and overwrite scripts stored on the server

tests.name: Full CRUD round-trip
tests.description: Save a script, verify it appears in list, load it back, then delete it and verify it's gone.
tests.expected: Save/list/load/delete all succeed, code matches after load, gone after delete

tests.name: Save overwrites existing script
tests.description: Save a script, then save again with the same name but different code. Load should return the new code.
tests.expected: Second save overwrites first, loaded code contains 'version_two'

tests.name: Save and list multiple scripts
tests.description: Save three scripts and verify ListScripts returns all of them.
tests.expected: List contains all three script names

tests.name: Save a script then run it by loading
tests.description: Save a script, load it back, then execute the loaded code via RunScript.

tests.name: LoadScript with nonexistent name
tests.description: Attempt to load a script that doesn't exist. Should return ScriptNotFound error.

tests.name: DeleteScript with nonexistent name
tests.description: Attempt to delete a script that doesn't exist. Should return ScriptNotFound error.

tests.name: Double-delete returns ScriptNotFound
tests.description: Save a script, delete it, then try to delete again. Second delete should fail with ScriptNotFound.
tests.expected: First delete succeeds, second returns ScriptNotFound

categories.name: Script Runner — Error Handling
categories.description: Error conditions: StopScript when idle, AlreadyRunning guard, and graceful failures

tests.name: StopScript when no script running
tests.description: Attempt to stop a script when none is running. Should return ScriptError.

tests.name: NameError (undefined variable)
tests.description: Run a script referencing an undefined variable. Should produce NameError in output.

tests.name: TypeError (wrong argument type)
tests.description: Run a script that causes a TypeError. Should produce TypeError in output.

tests.name: Output captured before exception
tests.description: Verify output printed before an exception is still captured in FullOutput.

tests.name: sys.exit() produces matching exit code
tests.description: Verify that calling sys.exit(2) in a script sets ExitCode to 2.

tests.name: Server stable after script error
tests.description: After a failed script, verify the server is still responsive by running a successful script.
tests.expected: First fails, second succeeds with ExitCode 0
